notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
